nodes.title: The Hangar's board themes and Comms rims now change the lesson: an equipped, OPEN board item tints the stage's slot and frame, an open rim colours her frame and PiP (cosmetics.ts lessonLook; the same 'open now' rule as the hull/trail on the engine); colour only, nothing a child can win or lose. The catalog grows from 9 to 21 items across subjects (hulls, trails, boards, rims, emotes), economy lint green. Reverse: the owner wants cosmetics off the lesson surface.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-hangar-applies`
Before this, a child could equip a board theme or a frame in the Hangar and nothing anywhere would change, which taught them the Hangar was decoration. Now the board they chose tints the stage where she teaches, and the frame they chose rings her window. Both stay colour only, and only for items the ledger has actually opened. The catalog has more to open across science, English and Hindi, so it isn't a maths-only world.
